test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The rescue team could have completed the task if there had been uninterrupted power supply.

options.text: The task could have been completed by the rescue team if there had been uninterrupted power supply.
The task could be completed by the rescue team if there was uninterrupted power supply.
The task could have to be completed by the rescue team if there was uninterrupted power supply.
The task can have completed by the rescue team if there was uninterrupted power supply.

solution:
The option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice is ‘1’ i.e. "The task could have been completed by the rescue team if there had been uninterrupted power supply."
